description: Risk check for an ERC-20 token on Base before buying, accepting, or holding it: reads the contract and its proxy implementation for owner powers (minting, pausing, blacklisting wallets, changing buy/sell taxes, trade limits, trading switches, burning others' tokens, upgrades), checks whether ownership was renounced and how much supply the owner holds. Returns a verdict, 0-100 risk score, and plain-language flags. Read-only. Not charged for invalid addresses or non-tokens. Paid via x402; see list_prices.
name: token_safety_check
title: Token safety check on Base: can the owner mint, pause, blacklist, change taxes, or upgrade?
